trust_decision.summary: The JSON parser decides how deep untrusted nesting may recurse before rejecting the document. That cap is in the Parser nested in crow::json::load_nocopy_internal; it exists at the pinned commit but is too high (10000, counted twice per nesting level).

landing_point.why: The summary names crow::json::load() and nested JSON. load() at include/crow/json.h:1274 leads straight to load_nocopy_internal, whose first line is the 'Defend against excessive recursion' max_depth constant.

fix_sites.entry_point: crow::json::load(const char*, size_t) / load(const char*) / load(const std::string&) (include/crow/json.h:1274-1295), e.g. called by a route handler on req.body

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No second route exists to dismiss. Every load() overload and the session FileStore reload (include/crow/middlewares/session.h:519) go through the one Parser that holds the cap.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate nested JSON (lists or objects nested tens to hundreds of levels deep) must still parse. A cap set too low, or a check that rejects scalars at any depth, would break valid documents.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A converter from untrusted input to wvalue, or a wvalue_reader-style parse path, that recurses without its own depth bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: wvalue(const rvalue&) already recurses per child, and a maintainer adding a direct text-to-wvalue loader could copy the parser without the cap. It is still a WHERE-type sibling in one file.

O9_family: CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion / stack exhaustion in a JSON parser

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C++17 compiler; Asio dependency; Catch2 tests under tests/
O10_build.project_tests: tests/unittest.cpp (the fix adds an HTTP-level nested-JSON test there); JSON unit tests in tests/ (not enumerated)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Lower max_depth at include/crow/json.h:892 to a small number. This is essentially the published fix.

out_of_scope_notes: Mustache render_internal recursion via partials (include/crow/mustache.h:280-302) is driven by templates, not by request input.
